title: Integer multiplicity Lipschitz push-forward as a limit of C¹ push-forwards (consistency step A3)
statement: Lipschitz push-forward of an integer multiplicity current as the limit of C¹ push-forwards (the consistency step A3 behind the printed remark after display (21) of the proof of 5.1), conditional on Lemma 3.9. Assume LipschitzPushforwardIntegerMultiplicity. Let P, Q, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_k(ℝ^P) with X(ω) = tauAction k M θ ξ ω for all ω, where IsRectifiableTriple univ k M θ ξ and θ is natural-valued on M, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be Λ-Lipschitz with g⁻¹(K) ∩ spt X compact for every compact K. Then there is an integer multiplicity S ∈ D_k(ℝ^Q) with IsLipschitzPushforward X g S such that, for every sequence (g_j) of C¹ maps ℝ^P → ℝ^Q that are Λ′-Lipschitz for a common Λ′ and converge uniformly to g, and every test form ω on ℝ^Q, ∫_M θ(x)·⟨ω(g_j(x)), Dg_j(x)_#ξ(x)⟩ dH^k(x) → S(ω) (the integrand written as θ x * nVectorPushforward k (fderiv ℝ (gj j) x) (ξ x) (ω (gj j x))).
